svg.title: Detail A: LakeFlow CDC lakehouse flow
svg.desc: Process-flow detail of the LakeFlow change-data-capture lakehouse: Postgres row changes leave through the write-ahead log into Debezium, then a Kafka topic log, then Spark Structured Streaming using foreachBatch. Data lands in a bronze vessel (raw, append-only), passes a data-quality gate valve that diverts failing rows to a quarantine with the rule name, and continues to silver and gold vessels: a Parquet lakehouse with idempotent merges and SCD Type 2 history. An Airflow DAG runs batch backfills with the same transforms.
